el.En distintos formatos —solista, dúo o ba: In different formats (solo, duo or band), the concert adapts to the needs of each gathering. It offers two sonic atmospheres: a first part with guitar and voice, warm, intimate and introspective, and a second in which backing tracks and samplers join in, interwoven with the acoustic instruments, inviting everyone to dance.
el.También suma canciones a pedido: covers,: He also adds songs on request: covers, mantras, medicine songs and instrumental music.

el.Un clima introspectivo, cálido e íntimo,: An introspective, warm and intimate atmosphere that invites contemplation and reflection.
el.Los instrumentos acústicos se mezclan co: Acoustic instruments blend with backing tracks and sampler to weave an electronic texture: the message of its poetry reaches you through the movement of the body and dance.
el.Ambos sets pueden ofrecerse por separado: Both sets can be offered separately or combined in a single concert.
el.Propuestas propias y en colaboración con: Original shows, and collaborations with other therapists.
